messages:
deploy-bot: Rolling change window start for gateway/inference-router -> v2.5.1. rollout=rng-2026-05-12-02. Canary=3% distributed. SLO gates: p95<230ms, 5xx<0.5% per-region over 10m.
sam-oncall: ACK. Watching eu-central and ap-northeast. Dash: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/serve/router?panelId=7
metrics-bot: Snapshot: global p95=175ms, eu-central p95=205ms, ap-northeast p95=188ms. global 5xx=0.08%.
nora-platform: Note: this release flips a routing flag to prefer local embed replicas. Watch embed-service cpu and DB pool.
metrics-bot: Alert (eu-central): embeds-service 5xx climbed to 0.66% over last 7m. Query: ```sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeds-service",region="eu-central",code=~"5.."}[7m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="embeds-service",region="eu-central"}[7m])) * 100```
sam-oncall: That's over our 0.5% threshold. Ops policy: region isolate and pause canary in region. @deploy-bot run: `route isolate --region eu-central --rollout rng-2026-05-12-02`
deploy-bot: Executing region isolate. Routing updated: eu-central canary -> stable v2.5.0. Global canary reduced to 1% (ap-northeast only). Rollout state: PARTIALLY_PAUSED. Note saved.
ops-bot: Incident filed: INC-2026-05-12-EU-EMBEDS. Link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-05-12-EU-EMBEDS
nora-platform: Traces point to embed-worker heap churn -> OOM kill attempts. Reverting routing flag for eu-central should stabilize. Plan: roll embed-replicaset back to rs-2026-05-10 then increase db.pool.maxConnections by 15.
sam-oncall: Good call. Keep canary isolated in eu-central. We'll monitor 30m before reintroducing 0.5% step. Leaving thread for platform to triage.
__notes: synthetic slack thread: deploy/monitoring coordination during change window, region isolate due to downstream embeds 5xx spike
